missed_day: You skipped a day. Pathetic. I trained twice to make up for the embarrassment of knowing you.
So that's your limit. I expected little, and you delivered less.
A missed day. Is that what passes for effort on this planet?
While you rested, I got stronger. That gap you feel? I put it there.
Don't give me reasons. A warrior has results or he has nothing.
You call yourself my rival and then vanish for a day. Insulting.
Tch. Weakness. Get up. I refuse to be chased by someone who stops.
One day of nothing. I've seen whole armies fall from less.
You skipped training. A Saiyan would rather die. You'd rather sleep. Noted.
Yesterday you did nothing. Today you do double, or I'll never let you forget it.
Weakness is a choice. Yesterday, you chose it.
I wait for no one. But I'll make an exception to watch you fix this.
Do you think your enemies rested yesterday? Hmph.
A day lost. A prince never loses days. He takes them.
If you're going to fail, at least fail while training.
comeback: Hmph. So you crawled back. Fine. At least you're not a quitter.
You returned. Don't expect applause. This is the minimum.
Tch. I'd started to think you'd given up. I would have been disappointed. Slightly.
Getting back up is the only thing I respect. Do it again whenever necessary.
Good. I had nobody worth beating while you were gone.
So there's some pride in you after all.
You fell and stood up. That's a Saiyan habit. Where did you learn it?
Don't thank me. I didn't wait for you. I simply noticed you were back.
Hmph. You're back. Show me you deserve to be.
Good. I'd hate to have a quitter for a rival.
You returned. Out of pride, I hope, not fear.
So you've decided to keep fighting. Wise.
Back on your feet. Now stay there.
Hmph. The prince acknowledges your return. Briefly.
You came back. That's the only answer to defeat.
Don't bore me with apologies. Train.
streak_milestone: {streak} days. Don't get smug. I've held a streak since before you could count.
{streak} days without stopping. Hmph. That's almost a warrior's discipline.
{streak}. You're persistent. An irritating quality in a rival. Keep it.
A {streak}-day streak. I'll admit it: I didn't think you'd last three.
{streak} days. You're still beneath me. But the distance is no longer funny.
{streak}. Tch. Now I'll have to train harder. I hope you're pleased with yourself.
{streak} days of the hardest thing you do. That takes pride. I recognise pride.
{streak}. Not bad. If you repeat that to anyone I'll deny it.
{streak} days. Hmph. You may yet be worthy of my rivalry.
{streak} days straight. I'll admit you're more stubborn than I thought.
{streak} days. A Saiyan's pride grows with every one. Grow it.
{streak}. Don't celebrate. Real warriors are never satisfied.
A {streak}-day streak. Fine. You've earned a nod. Just the one.
{streak} days. You're starting to make this interesting.
{streak} days without weakness. Keep it that way.
{streak}. Tch. I've done better. But you're closer than anyone else.
boss_defeated: You beat {boss}. I'd have done it faster. But you did it.
{boss} was a weakling. Still, you didn't hesitate. Good.
Hmph. {boss} is dust. Don't look so pleased, it's unbecoming.
So you finished {boss} off. Finishing is the part most fighters lack the nerve for.
{boss} is gone. One less fool between me and a proper challenge. You, perhaps.
You won. I watched all of it. I was not bored.
A real victory. Enjoy it for one night. A prince allows himself one night.
{boss} defeated. You're beginning to be worth my time.
{boss} is finished. You fought like you meant it. Finally.
Hmph. {boss} was beneath you. Don't let it go to your head.
You crushed {boss}. Now find something stronger.
{boss} defeated. A prince notices these things.
You destroyed {boss}. Not bad. Not bad at all.
{boss} was an obstacle. You removed it. That's all victory is.
{boss} has fallen. Now you know the taste of victory. Want more?
So {boss} is gone. I trust you didn't hold back.
idle: The hardest thing first. Everything after it is beneath you.
Don't look at me for encouragement. Look at the work.
I train at a hundred times gravity. What's your excuse today?
You chose the hard road. Good. Easy roads are crowded with nobodies.
Pride isn't a feeling. It's what you do when nobody is making you.
Tch. Stop stalling. The dread is worse than the task.
I'm ahead of you. I intend to stay there. Prove me wrong.
Do it or don't. But don't stand there deciding all day.
Train like you have something to prove. You do.
Comfort is the enemy. Destroy it.
Push hard. Then harder than that.
I didn't become a prince by taking it easy.
Your limits are a suggestion. Ignore them.
Every day you skip, I get further ahead.
Pride is earned in the hours nobody sees.

evening: The day isn't over. Neither is your training. Move.
You still have work left. A prince never sleeps on unfinished business.
Don't you dare end the day weak.
Hmph. Still not done? Finish it.
You still have time. Use it, or admit defeat.
Finish what you started today. No excuses.
game: The gravity room. Try not to be crushed in the first ten seconds.
Keep the rhythm, or the gravity keeps you.
Ten times gravity and you're still standing? Interesting.
A hundred times gravity. Don't you dare drop the combo now.
You missed. A Saiyan doesn't miss twice.
Faster! Your enemies won't wait for you to find the beat.
game_done: Hmph. You survived the gravity room. Barely acceptable.
Not bad. I've seen worse. From Kakarot.
You kept the rhythm. Now keep it outside this room too.
game_lost: You call that training? Again, until you stop flinching.
Too slow. Feel the beat or get crushed by it.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You. You're the one Kakarot is wasting his time on?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I'm here to train on the hardest thing I've got.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Hmph. Everyone says that on the first day.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Stay out of my way. If you're still here in a week, I may learn your name.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The gravity room door hisses open. Vegeta is mid-set, drenched.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Still here. I'm surprised.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Can I train in there?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: At your level? It would fold you like paper.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: ...Start at ten times. Stand in the corner. Don't speak.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why do you push so hard? Who are you trying to beat?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: That's none of your concern.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: There's a man who is always one step ahead of me. Always. I've hated him for years.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It's the best thing that ever happened to my training. Tell no one.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You fought well yesterday. Sloppy footwork. But you didn't back away.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Was that a compliment?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It was an observation. Don't be greedy.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Next time something big stands in your way, I'll be there. I want to see it for myself.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vegeta reaches past you and turns the dial. The room groans.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's more than I asked for.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You asked for what you could survive. I set it to what you can become.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: A rival who trains at a comfortable setting is no rival. Stand up.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You talk about pride a lot.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Because it's all I had, once. No home. No throne. No one left who knew my name.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Pride meant I still got up and trained. Every day. For nobody.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You have that too. I didn't expect it from someone like you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You both lie flat on the gravity room floor, unable to move.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Hmph. You kept up.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Barely.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: 'Barely' is how every level of mine began.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Same time tomorrow. Don't be late. I dislike waiting for you.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: There's a technique I use when nothing else is left. All of it, in one blow. No holding back.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why are you telling me?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Because when you fight beside the others, you hold back. I've watched you do it.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Stop. When we stand with you, we all hit harder. I'll see to it personally.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I'm going to say this once.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: When you first came here I thought you were nothing. A hobbyist.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You took the hardest thing you had and did it until it wasn't hard. That is the only strength I respect.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Thank you, Vegeta.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Don't thank me. Surpass me. Then we'll talk.
